parts.text:
Based on the BS Chemistry curriculum document, a student must complete the following programme requirements to graduate:

* Total credits: 27 (3+4+4+3+3+2+2+4+4+3+3+2+1+2+1)
* Core courses:
	+ Introduction to Electrical Engineering
	+ Engineering Mechanics
	+ Introduction to Computer Science
	+ Chemistry
	+ Physics
	+ Mathematics I
	+ Mathematics II
* Elective courses:
	+ Introduction to Bioengineering
	+ Engineering Visualization
	+ Engineering Realization
	+ Engineering Design I
	+ Engineering Design II
	+ Communication Skill I
	+ Communication Skill II
	+ Social Connect and responsibilities I
	+ Social Connect and responsibilities II
	+ Performing Arts I/Sports I
	+ Performing Arts II/Sports II
* Laboratory courses:
	+ Chemistry Lab
	+ Physics Lab

Please note that this is based on the information provided in the search results and may not be a comprehensive list of requirements. It's always best to consult the official curriculum document for the most up-to-date and accurate information.
